publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Inherited regulator state changes admission
record.method: Identical pre-XNU snapshot program through two loaders; register readback
record.observation: The Tow-Boot and SD U-Boot handoffs differ in 26 reported records. The 7E18 camera policy verifies and adopts the already enabled 2.8 V analog rail and preserves unowned fields, rather than requiring an all-off baseline.
record.limits: Programmed selectors are not measured voltages. Battery state and SD presence differ; not every observed difference is caused solely by the loader. Legacy camera admission remains separate.
